fact: The Budget Minister said pilot firms had already begun filing declarations online on the e Tax portal launched 14 September 2020.
The Budget Minister said pilot firms were paying online through e Tax, with GNF 45bn declared and paid online by 11 September 2020.
The government has launched the eTax platform for online tax declaration (télédéclaration), according to We are Tech.
The eTax platform also allows online payment (télépaiement) of taxes, according to We are Tech.
